Currentweather/gust cannot be directly compared without matching averaging,height/exposure conventions
SoilGrids texture alone does not establish British soilgroup or rootabledepth
Standalone forest model needs spacing/density and edge context
No supplied identification of ArborScan dynamic beta kg/s from image, species or CD alone
